Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in Step 3 by incorrectly concluding that "South of the Border" has a stage adaptation based on ambiguous and irrelevant search results. Specifically, the Planner misinterpreted a "South of the Border - The Musical" listing found in previous search results (which was likely a different work, possibly a jukebox musical or unrelated production) as evidence that the 2009 Oliver Stone documentary film had been adapted for the stage. The Planner failed to distinguish between unrelated works sharing the same title and did not verify if the specific film in question (the 2009 documentary) had a stage version. This led to a false positive conclusion that both films had stage adaptations, when in fact only "Buried Country" did. The error stems from a failure to rigorously validate the connection between the film title and the stage production, relying instead on superficial keyword matches in search snippets.
